title: Leanstral 1.5: Mistral's Open Model for Formal Verification
hook: A 6B-active-parameter open model that saturates miniF2F and solves 587 of 672 PutnamBench problems — and found five previously unknown bugs across 57 real repositories.
key_points: Leanstral 1.5, Apache-2.0 licensed, has 6B active parameters and specializes in formal verification and automated theorem proving.
Saturates miniF2F, solves 587/672 PutnamBench problems, and sets state-of-the-art on FATE-H (87%) and FATE-X (34%).
Trained through mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and RL with CISPO, aimed at agentic proof engineering and real-world code verification.
Found 5 previously unknown bugs across 57 tested repositories — formal verification catching real-world issues, not just benchmark problems.
content_html: Formal verification is the strongest guarantee software correctness can get, but writing the proofs is famously slow work even for experts. Mistral's Leanstral 1.5 targets exactly that bottleneck, and ships it as an open, Apache-2.0 model.
extra_html: With 6B active parameters, Leanstral 1.5 delivers a major jump in formal-verification capability: it saturates miniF2F, solves 587 of 672 PutnamBench problems, and sets state-of-the-art results on FATE-H (87%) and FATE-X (34%). The model went through mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with CISPO, aimed squarely at agentic proof engineering and real-world code verification. The most concrete evidence its capability generalizes past curated benchmarks: testing it against 57 real repositories turned up five previously unknown bugs. Announced via Mistral AI, reported on r/LocalLLaMA, 2026-07-03.

related.hook: Prior LLM provers force the model into a fixed, human-designed strategy and still prove only a fraction of their targets. A free-roaming Claude Code agent, unconstrained, proves every single one.
